args.body:
Hi Tomas,

Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear that order SO-79799 arrived two days late and that one carton was crushed.

Here's what happens next:

1. I've logged the late delivery and the damaged carton against order SO-79799.
2. Our team will review the shipment and the damage to the affected carton. If you can send a photo of the crushed carton and note which items were inside, that will help us resolve this faster.
3. Depending on the review, we'll arrange a replacement or a partial refund for the damaged goods, and we'll follow up with you directly with the outcome.

If anything inside the crushed carton is unusable, please set it aside for now so we can assess it.

Apologies again for the inconvenience — we'll be in touch shortly.

Best regards,
Northwind Analytics Support
